# P03 typed FAQ: faithful reference and native help

The fifth private typed adapter implements [ADR-0041](../adr/0041-explicit-faq-reference-and-native-details.md).
It makes purchased FAQ styling usable with app-owned plain text, stable identities
and multiple instances. `NewFAQReference` retains the original Elements structure;
`NewFAQDetails` explicitly offers native independent disclosures without JavaScript.
This is one frozen source-specific candidate, not a general accordion or certified target.

## Delivered and proven

| Evidence | Result |
|---|---|
| Exact frozen source and replay | P03 archive/member/body identity checked before adaptation or export; legacy and Elements rules unchanged |
| Private CLI delivery | Repeat JSON identical; six immutable files, exact checks, private modes, no-clobber and per-file drift refusal pass |
| Standalone compilation | Raw and templ-formatted copies compile/test in independent `example.invalid/faq-proof` modules; no app-kit import/sibling checkout; offline cached dependencies |
| Deterministic preparation | Two final preparations reproduce all 26 files, including manifest, byte-for-byte |
| Browser | One run260/260; subsequent diagnostic run266/268 because the SVG image pair and its aggregate fail. All native/interaction/model checks pass at390/1440, light/dark and JS disabled; repeatability open |
| Source/reference fidelity | Exact namespace-aware DOM; one run has eight byte-identical PNG pairs, but repeat runs retain an intermittent 28-pixel SVG mismatch. Visual repeatability remains open; no masks/tolerance |
| Native content and interaction | Both six-item instances preserve exact ordered heading/question/answer/derived ID/initial state; all answers reachable independently; icons, focus, 44px targets and long-content wrapping pass |
| Real browser zoom | Chrome setting 200%; DPR2, outer1440/inner720/client720/scroll720; native task passes |
| Containment | 56 admitted local GET browser requests; native requests no module; mismatched/null Origin refused; source without runtime cannot toggle |
| Discovery | 30 shared catalog records; five typed private adapters, experimental CLI-only references with no certified web target |

Constructors validate 1–24 items, bounded UTF-8 plain text and injective prefix/key
identities, snapshot inputs, escape content and preserve cancellation/writer errors.
Independent Go/browser assertions bind actual content to the model; altered text,
IDs and open state trip mutation canaries. The browser independently binds the copied
source manifest, wrappers, CSS, font and runtime to the frozen reference. Rehashed
manifest/wrapper/CSS/font/runtime/source substitutions are refused.

Go1.26.3, templ0.3.1020, Playwright1.63.0 and Chrome152.0.7977.84 on macOS arm64.
Ordinary cases use DPR1/100% zoom and reduced motion. Source transitions are retained.
Each source/reference image must stabilize independently before cross-lane comparison;
all final captures stabilized on the second image, without selecting against its peer.

## Failures retained and repaired

- First private preparation refused because its dependency comparison included the
  generated module's different temporary directories. Only that exact own-module
  record is now normalized; external paths and kit-dependency refusal remain checked.
- Review found source-manifest anchoring and native-content oracle gaps. Both were
  strengthened before accepting browser evidence; no previous oracle was weakened.
- First browser run stalled on page callbacks with document scripting disabled.
  Bounded Node-side settlement replaces those callbacks. `display: contents` hosts
  are checked through visible descendants, not a nonexistent host layout box.
- Open-state images intermittently differ at 28 pixels in the first minus icon.
  Runtime DOM, SVG rectangles and computed styles match. Independent frame stability
  and a disabled-GPU trial did not establish repeatability; these runs remain failures.
  SwiftShader also failed. Both ineffective renderer flags were removed. Paint-lifecycle
  isolation remains under investigation; cause is not established, tolerance stays zero.
- Native long headings genuinely overflowed, including scroll width8531 at200% zoom.
  A native-only root marker and scoped heading wrapping fix it without changing the
  original/reference markup, hiding text or shrinking typography.
- Source still produces 28 small-target observations across the paired cases. These
  are repeated observations, not 28 distinct components, and remain source findings.

A bounded390px paint probe repeats three conditions three times. Initial images are
9/9 paired-identical; open images match2/3 with source first,2/3 with reference first,
and1/3 with a fresh process per lane. Both render variants occur in either lane;
neither order nor process isolation establishes repeatability. The retained raw DOM,
state and icon observations agree, but the probe's initial icon predicate was inverted
and corrected only afterward; no aggregate functional pass is claimed from that probe.
Its independent PNG predicates still falsify every proposed deterministic control.
